The exact HFT trace connects the supplied wanting, eye, and worldly-adornment occurrences in 18:28 to the focus ornament, gold, and clothing occurrences in 18:31; the unresolved records are retained as attributed context rather than given invented lexical glosses.

The exact HFT trace supplies matched enclosure, water, covering, and resting-place contacts in 18:29 and 18:31, with a specific reversal from injurious service to sustaining hospitality; unresolved branch records remain attributed.

The exact HFT trace links the preserved wage in 18:30, the owner's self-authored return in 18:36, the focus reward and clothing, and the authorized verdict in 18:44; every supplied branch is landed or attributed without adding a gloss to unresolved records.

The exact HFT trace compares the productive but vulnerable worldly garden with the focus's continuing flow, stable habitation, and useful resting place; the attributed unresolved branches are supported by named context coordinates and return to focus words.

The exact HFT trace joins the failed faction in 18:43 and divine protective governance in 18:44 to the focus's reclining, companionship, and support-place; the relation is medium-strength but specific and bounded, so it remains qualified rather than suppressed.

The outlier has an explicit focus anchor in the below/above arrangement, independent collapse and trellis contacts in 18:42, and a stated structural boundary; its surprising cross-scene relation is retained as attributed evidence rather than treated as lexical equivalence.

The outlier has a focus carrier in خُضْرًا, independent ripe-fruit and collapse contacts, and an explicit analogy-only containment rule; it survives as an exploratory material analogy without being promoted to the ordinary color gloss.

findings.title: Adornment and reclining materialize a good rest
findings.claim: The focus presents reward as a materially settled reception: flowing gardens, received ornament, covering, reclining, enclosed couches, and a useful resting place explain one another as the form of a good rest.
findings.mechanism: The garden, river, ornament, garment, reclining, couch, and resting-place carriers are independently joined by neighboring reward and counter-rest context, so the closing praise turns an inventory of luxuries into an embodied environment of stable reception.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the final good resting place is more than a label: the reward is made inhabitable through flow, enclosure, adornment, support, and ease.
findings.containment: The primary scene remains literal gardens, jewelry, clothing, reclining, and praise. The finding does not claim that every branch is a separate doctrine or that the focus replaces its ordinary reward description.

epistemic.reason: The channel nomination, focus branch records, and focus surface all provide direct, mutually connected evidence; the macro extension is bounded by the supplied neighboring context.
